papers.title: Keypoint Action Tokens Enable In-Context Imitation Learning in Robotics
papers.title_zh: 关键点动作令牌实现机器人上下文模仿学习
papers.tldr_zh: 无需额外训练，文本Transformer通过关键点动作令牌实现少样本视觉模仿学习。
papers.cover_zh: 文本模型也能操控机器人？关键点动作令牌让模仿学习无需训练直接上手
papers.abstract_zh: 我们展示了现成的基于文本的Transformer，无需额外训练，即可执行少样本上下文视觉模仿学习，将视觉观察映射为模仿演示者行为的动作序列。我们通过一个称为关键点动作令牌（KAT）的框架实现这一点，将视觉观察（输入）和动作轨迹（输出）转换为文本预训练Transformer（GPT-4 Turbo）可以接收和生成的令牌序列。尽管仅在语言上训练，我们表明这些Transformer在将标记化的视觉关键点观察转换为动作轨迹方面表现出色，在一系列真实世界日常任务的低数据场景下，性能与最先进的模仿学习（扩散策略）相当或更优。KAT并非像通常那样在语言领域操作，而是利用基于文本的Transformer在视觉和动作领域操作，从演示数据中学习通用模式，实现高效模仿学习，为将自然语言模型重新用于具身任务开辟了有希望的新途径。视频见https://www.robot-learning.uk/keypoint-action-tokens。

papers.title: ShapeFusion: A 3D diffusion model for localized shape editing
papers.title_zh: ShapeFusion: A 3D diffusion model for localized shape editing

papers.cover_zh: In the realm of 3D computer vision, parametric models have e
papers.abstract_zh: In the realm of 3D computer vision, parametric models have emerged as a ground-breaking methodology for the creation of realistic and expressive 3D avatars. Traditionally, they rely on Principal Component Analysis (PCA), given its ability to decompose data to an orthonormal space that maximally captures shape variations. However, due to the orthogonality constraints and the global nature of PCA's decomposition, these models struggle to perform localized and disentangled editing of 3D shapes, which severely affects their use in applications requiring fine control such as face sculpting. In this paper, we leverage diffusion models to enable diverse and fully localized edits on 3D meshes, while completely preserving the un-edited regions. We propose an effective diffusion masking training strategy that, by design, facilitates localized manipulation of any shape region, without being limited to predefined regions or to sparse sets of predefined control vertices. Following our framework, a user can explicitly set their manipulation region of choice and define an arbitrary set of vertices as handles to edit a 3D mesh. Compared to the current state-of-the-art our method leads to more interpretable shape manipulations than methods relying on latent code state, greater localization and generation diversity while offering faster inference than optimization based approaches. Project page: https://rolpotamias.github.io/Shapefusion/
